name: LIBA

about.text: Loyola Institute of Business Administration (LIBA), located in the lively city of Chennai, is a leading business school noted for its dedication to academic achievement and the overall development of its students. LIBA, founded in 1979, has a solid reputation for developing corporate leaders that benefit society.

LIBA provides management programs ranging from a two-year full-time Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) through part-time PGDM programs for working professionals, executive education programs, and Ph.D. programs. LIBA provides students with the skills and competencies needed to prosper in today's dynamic business world through a challenging program that combines theoretical knowledge and practical experience.

about.text: LIBA's faculty is one of its distinctive aspects. The faculty, which includes seasoned academicians and industry practitioners, provides the classroom with a wealth of knowledge and skills. They engage students in thought-provoking conversations, case studies, and research projects, cultivating an intellectual inquiry and critical thinking culture.

LIBA's dedication to comprehensive development goes beyond the classroom. The institution places a premium on values-driven leadership and ethical decision-making. LIBA instils a feeling of social responsibility in its students and encourages them to become socially conscious business leaders through various co-curricular activities, student groups, and social projects.

LIBA's state-of-the-art campus provides a perfect setting for study and development. The institute is outfitted with cutting-edge technology, such as large classrooms, a well-stocked library, computer laboratories, a dedicated auditorium, and recreational facilities. The tranquil campus location encourages thought, teamwork, and personal development.

aboutBoxes.title: Top-Ranked University
aboutBoxes.content: In 2023, the NIRF MBA comparison rating placed Loyola Institute of Business Administration 7 out of 200. It is recognised as the 2nd best institution in India for science and arts and the 3rd best college for commerce.

aboutBoxes.title: Great Placement Assistance
aboutBoxes.content: LIBA offers its alums the greatest placement help in many large corporations. Deloitte, RBI, Britannia, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Asian Paints, and BYJUS are among the top LIBA Chennai campus placement recruiters.

aboutBoxes.title: International Tie-ups
aboutBoxes.content: LIBA offers several international exchange/collaboration programs with universities in Asia, Europe, and the United States. These programs allow students to travel to other places and experience different cultures.

facts: LIBA was founded in 1979 and is a component of the prestigious Loyola College with a 95-year history. NBA has accredited the institute, and the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) has recognized it.

LIBA provides management programs ranging from a two-year full-time Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) through part-time PGDM programs for working professionals, executive education programs, and Ph.D. programs.

LIBA has a remarkable faculty that includes both experienced academics and industry practitioners. They offer expertise and industry insights to the classroom, ensuring students have a meaningful learning experience.

LIBA places a premium on values-based leadership and ethical decision-making. The institution promotes a culture of social responsibility and encourages students to make meaningful contributions to society.

LIBA's campus is modern, with large classrooms, a well-stocked library, computer labs, an auditorium, and recreational facilities. The tranquil campus location is great for academics and personal development.

LIBA maintains strong industry relationships and cooperation, giving students several internships, real projects, and placement options. The institute has a good track record of placing students in prestigious firms across various industries.

LIBA is accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA) and has been recognised by major organisations such as the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and the Association of Jesuit Business Schools (AJBS).

LIBA has routinely ranked among India's best business schools. It has received national and worldwide recognition for academic achievement, faculty competence, and industrial relevance in various national and international rankings.

LIBA encourages its staff and students to engage in research and academic pursuits. The institution publishes research articles in prestigious journals and holds conferences and seminars to enhance information exchange.
LIBA has an active alum network that spans sectors and continents. The alum network is a significant resource for networking, mentorship, and professional development.

emi.text: LIBA respects students' financial concerns and works hard to provide them with simple payment choices. In addition to providing EMI options, the school is committed to making education accessible and inexpensive to qualified individuals. LIBA aspires to guarantee that financial restrictions do not prevent students from achieving their academic goals by providing flexible payment arrangements. This dedication to student assistance distinguishes LIBA as an institution that values the well-being and success of its students.

admission.text: The admissions procedure at LIBA (Loyola Institute of Business Administration) is multi-staged to guarantee that worthy students are selected. Here's a quick rundown of the admissions procedure:

Step 1: Candidates must satisfy the stipulated eligibility standards, which often include a bachelor's degree from a recognised university with a minimum percentage or CGPA. Admission tests such as the CAT/XAT/GMAT/CMAT may also be necessary.

Step 2: Interested Candidates should complete the online application form accessible on the official LIBA website. Personal and educational information, job experience (if applicable), and other pertinent information are required on the form.
Step 3: Candidates must submit their scores from recognized entry tests such as the CAT, XAT, GMAT, or CMAT. These scores are taken into account throughout the selection process.

Step 4: Candidates who have been shortlisted are invited to participate in the WAT and PI rounds. The WAT analyses the candidate's writing abilities and analytical thinking, while the PI considers their communication abilities, personality attributes, and program appropriateness.

Step 5: The candidate's entire performance is considered, which includes their entrance exam scores, WAT and PI performance, academic record, employment experience (if any), and other pertinent aspects. Selected candidates are contacted through email via the official LIBA website.

It should be noted that the specific admittance process may differ significantly from year to year. Candidates should consult the official LIBA website or entrance brochure for the most up-to-date and thorough information.

faqs.q: What are the entrance requirements for LIBA?
faqs.a: A bachelor's degree with a minimum percentage or CGPA criterion is often required for admission to the PGDM program. Candidates must also take national-level admission tests such as the CAT, XAT, GMAT, or CMAT.

Yes, LIBA provides merit and need-based scholarships to outstanding students. Scholarships are based on various characteristics, including academic performance, admission exam results, and general profile.

faqs.q: What is the student-faculty ratio at LIBA?
faqs.a: LIBA maintains a good faculty-student ratio to ensure customized attention and successful learning. The institution has a team of seasoned and well-educated faculty members that bring a wealth of academic knowledge and industrial expertise.

faqs.q: Does LIBA provide prospects for worldwide exposure?
faqs.a: Yes, LIBA offers international exposure through student exchange programs, international conferences, and alliances with reputable worldwide institutions. Students benefit from these opportunities to extend their views and obtain a global perspective.

faqs.q: How is the job placement situation at LIBA?
faqs.a: LIBA has a strong track record of placement. The institute's Placement Cell collaborates closely with industry partners to support campus placements. LIBA has developed excellent relationships with diverse firms across industries, resulting in attractive employment options for students.

faqs.q: What is the LIBA teaching methodology?
faqs.a: LIBA uses various teaching methods, including lectures, case studies, group discussions, industry guest speakers, experiential learning, and simulations. The emphasis is on the practical application of knowledge, critical thinking, and developing strong problem-solving abilities.

faqs.q: Does LIBA provide summer internship opportunities?
faqs.a: Yes, LIBA offers students summer internship possibilities as part of the PGDM curriculum. The institution maintains partnerships with several organizations, allowing students to obtain real-world experience.
